description: ADO-VIEW: client static recordset of K; Filter with LIKE patterns, one varied at a time, on text column T ('a*', 'a%', '*a*', '%a%', 'alpha', 'alph?', 'alph_') and on Code ('a*', 'a%', '%1', '*1'); each Filter's error, RecordCount and first ID, the filter cleared between. Then Sort 'L DESC, ID' (ids in order), Sort '' (ids in order). Resolves the earlier contradiction on % in Filter LIKE and asks whether clearing Sort restores the original order.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-ado-misc probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
